groqApiKey.title: Groq API key (optional)
groqApiKey.description: For fast cloud transcription of lectures without captions (under 20 s per hour of audio, about $0.04 per hour). Create a free key at https://console.groq.com/keys and paste it here. Leave it empty to transcribe locally on your computer instead. With a key, the audio of recordings you transcribe is sent to Groq.
